column1: 曩日釋迦如來菩提樹下坐，
column2: Once upon a time, Śākyamuni the Thus-Come One sat beneath the Bodhi tree amidst a great assembly.

column1: 大眾集會中。 時馬鳴菩薩前白佛言： 「欲說我莊嚴佛法， 及為成像末貧窮下賤裸形眾生有情衣服，
column2: At that time Aśvaghoṣa Bodhisattva came before the Buddha and said, ‘I wish to speak my sublime Buddhadharma so that come the Semblance and Final [Dharma periods], the masses of the low and destitute and the myriad sentient beings who are naked will be clothed.

column1: 歷無數劫行菩薩行所得大神呪， 有大威德，
column2: Having passed countless kalpas treading the path of the bodhisattva, the great spirit-spell that I have obtained is of surpassing power and virtue.

column1: 色力無比， 能於世間行殊勝事無能礙罣。
column2: Its power within [the realm of] form is beyond compare, and it is capable of accomplishing the most excellent deeds in the world.

column1: 」時即佛微㗛告馬鳴菩薩言： 「善哉！
column2: It cannot be hindered.’ The Buddha then smiled and said to Aśvaghoṣa Bodhisattva, ‘Excellent, brave sir!

column1: 大丈夫！ 汝速可說可說。 」「唯然。 世尊愍念我聽說。 」合掌歡喜從口中放大光明，
column2: Quickly, speak, speak!’ ‘Yes, the World-Honored One has such thoughts of pity,’ [replied Aśvaghoṣa,] ‘I will follow his words.’ He joined his palms together joyously and from his mouth issued forth a great ray of light.

column1: 說光中神呪曰： 「曩謨三曼多沒他那迦迦馬鳴吃哩吒囉佉吒囉佉莎縛訶」「若欲受持此法， 先從師盡財利布施供給， 受習印契真言。
column2: Spoken from within the light was this spirit-spell: ‘Nang-mo-san-man-duo-mei-ta-na-jia-jia-ma-ming-chi-li-zha-luo-qu-zha-luo-qu-sha-fu-he.’ If one wishes to receive and maintain this method, one must first follow a master, exhaust one’s wealth making generous offerings, and receive and practice the mudrā [later described] and mantra [just recited].

column1: 則畫作菩薩像，
column2: Then paint an image of the bodhisattva.

column1: 色相白肉色而合掌，
column2: His body appears in the color of white flesh.

column1: 坐白蓮華， 乘白馬，
column2: His palms are joined together as he sits upon a white lotus flower, which is mounted upon a white horse.

column1: 著白色衣， 以瓔珞莊嚴身，
column2: He is wearing white clothing, and a necklace of precious stones adorns his body.

column1: 首戴花冠， 垂右足。
column2: Upon his head he wears a floral crown, and his right leg is pendent.

column1: 畫像了， 泥壇。
column2: After painting the image, smear the altar [with ox dung?]

column1: 始自三月三日，
column2: and begin [the following rite] from the third day of the third month.

column1: 東面像向西， 以種種廣大供具、蘇乳蘇燈供養。
column2: Face east toward the image, which is to face west, and make offerings of butter lamps and all other sorts of excellent offerings for twenty-eight days.

column1: 二十八日乃至百日， 須清淨潔淨。
column2: Up until the one-hundredth day, one must cleanse and purify oneself.

column1: 比丘及傳法利生之師， 恩不已失，
column2: For a bhikṣu [monk], when it comes to the kindness of the master who has transmitted this method for the benefit of the living, he must not be delinquent in this timing.

column1: 時我常檀那家及國土放大光明，
column2: [In this way,] I will always shine great rays of light upon the household and kingdom of the dāna[pati] [donor].

column1: 成就錦繡羅綿財絹縺緻之類，
column2: He or she will obtain all kinds of rich brocades, patterned silks, money, firm silks, and fine woven silks.

column1: 金寶積如山岳， 世間受用咨(矣)。
column2: Treasures of gold will pile up like a mountain for all the world to enjoy!

column1: 「若有一國一人修行， 我本誓故， 普天率土民家皆悉如前所說，
column2: If there is but one person in a kingdom who puts into practice my original vow, all the people of the entire kingdom will be as said before.

column1: 財利莊嚴具成就。 一人莫乏有患，
column2: Completely perfecting wealth and adornments, not a single person will be poor or have sickness.

column1: 我本願皆悉為莊嚴財寶。
column2: My original vow is that all will be adorned with riches.

column1: 於若法至疑惑之心， 發起不信之念， 不成就一世之願故， 後世之果不定。
column2: If this method attains to a mind of doubt, which gives rise to thoughts of disbelief, and the vows of one generation are not realized, then the fruits of future generations will be uncertain.

column1: 好好以堅固之情歸於法， 非忌傳授之德，
column2: It is best to take refuge in this method with a feeling of resolution, and not shun the virtue that has been transmitted.

column1: 我必日日時時加護念， 圓滿世間第一妙樂之財利。
column2: [Thus] I shall, continuously day after day, hold to this thought of divine protection: I will fill the entire world with the profit and riches of the utmost sublime bliss.

column1: 如向所說， 係念本誓，
column2: If one seeks that of which I have spoken, one must fix one’s mind upon this original vow.

column1: 向寶壇前作契印念誦。
column2: Standing before and facing the precious platform, form [the following] mudrā and recite [the above mantra].

column1: 屈左中指無名指， 以大母指押彼二指甲， 舒頭指及小指安心上，
column2: Bend the middle finger and ring finger of the left hand, and with the thumb press these two fingernails [against the palm]. Extend the forefinger and pinky finger and place [the hand] upon the heart.

column1: 右手把數珠念真言，
column2: With the right hand [count] the recitations of the mantra with a rosary.

column1: 此名玉環成就一切所願印。
column2: This is called the Jade-Bracelet-All-Vow-Fulfilling mudrā.

column1: 此契印， 末代愚學之妄， 不可記於文字。
column2: In the age of the Final [Dharma], ignorant [people] of shallow learning will be unable to record this mudrā in written words.

column1: 萬人中撰十人， 十人之中撰一人， 許可(矣)。
column2: Among ten thousand people ten will be chosen, and among ten people one will be chosen and permitted [to receive the transmission of this teaching].
